boxBlock.note: Step_0:31-32. Anchor verified unique in the file (grep -cF == 1). No endAnchor needed: ifStatementEnd walks the if's parens, finds no '{', and stops at the ';' of the instance_create, so the slice is exactly the two lines and is brace-balanced. The box is a FIXED single box - (viewX + 320, viewY + 170), obj_growtangle's own defaults - and does NOT self-select on the attack; every leapmode uses the same one. obj_growtangle in Ch1 has no maxxscale/maxyscale fields at all (gml_Object_obj_growtangle_Create_0.gml:1-11); it grows image_x/yscale from 0 to a hard-coded 2 over maxtimer = 15 frames (gml_Object_obj_growtangle_Step_0.gml:17-18). spr_battlebg_0 is 75x75 origin 37,37, so the final box is 150x150 centred on (viewX+320, viewY+170): floor at viewY+245, which is the surface leapmodes 0 and 1 land on. DO NOT move the anchor up to the enclosing `if (global.monsterhp[myself] > milkmax)` (Step_0:26) unless you also define milkmax - that gate is the MILK phase test and it also carries scr_moveheart() (Step_0:29).

turnBlock.note: Step_0:94 only. `global.turntimer = 999;` is NOT unique in the file (3 hits: :94, :160, :299) but :94 is the first, which is what extractTurnBlock takes, and both :160 and :299 belong to the milk cutscene. `attacked = 1;` IS unique (:95). The slice is the single statement `global.turntimer = 999;`.

turnBlockNote: 999 is a SENTINEL, not a duration. K. Round's turn is self-terminating: obj_checkers_leap sets `global.turntimer = -1;` when its own animation finishes (gml_Object_obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml:84 for leapmode 0, :111 for 1, :337 for 2, :427 for 3, :500 for 4) and only then destroys itself and restores `obj_checkers_enemy.visible = 1`. obj_battlecontroller_Step_0.gml:831-856 decrements global.turntimer every frame while global.mnfight == 2 and closes the turn at <= 0. So a studio that hard-caps the turn at its default floor will cut every K. Round attack off mid-animation, and a studio that honours 999 will hang for 999 frames unless it also runs the leap object's terminator. Use `turnByChoice` below as the practical budget, or -1 to mean 'run until the controller says stop'.

dispatchBlock.note: Step_0:65-87, the WHOLE chooser + spawn in one brace-balanced block (line 87 closes it). Anchor verified unique (grep -cF == 1). This is both the chooser and the dispatcher: it maps `attacktype` to `rr`, creates obj_checkers_leap, sets leapmode/target/damage, and then advances `attacktype` itself. Replay this INSTEAD of manually creating a controller - never in addition, or the `!instance_exists` guard will have already been satisfied and nothing will spawn. Requires `attacktype` (int 0-3) and `mytarget` to exist on self, and global.monsterat[myself] to be set.

selectorScan.note: Deliberately pointed at the CONTROLLER, not the boss. A scan of obj_checkers_enemy_Step_0.gml finds nothing useful: gen_attacks.js's regex is `<var>\s*==\s*(-?\d+)` and the boss file contains no `rr ==` comparison at all (rr is only ever written: Step_0:68/71/74/77/80/98), while `attacktype == N` (Step_0:67/70/73/76) sits in four one-line windows that contain no instance_create, so three of the four would be skipped outright. Scanning `leapmode` on the leap's Step yields exactly five hits (:1, :94, :225, :346, :436) whose windows are the five attack bodies. Two caveats: (a) the `controller` the regex reports is wrong - it picks up the first instance_create in each window, giving obj_shake for leapmode 0 and 1 and obj_regularbullet for 2 and 3; the real controller is obj_checkers_leap itself. (b) leapmode 4's window contains NO instance_create, so gen_attacks.js will `continue` past it and report 4 attacks - correct by accident, since leapmode 4 is the cut one. All five branch bodies are under the 3500-char `setup` cap (2216 / 3218 / 2768 / 1932 / 1534 bytes).

chooser.note: NOT random. `attacktype` is a deterministic cycling counter: Create_0.gml:37 initialises it to 0, and Step_0:83-86 is the only place it is ever written (`attacktype += 1;` then wrap at > 3). So the attack order is FIXED and identical in both fights: leapmode 0 -> 3 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0 -> ... Every one of the four values is reachable on turn 1..4, and nothing else can be produced. The only other write to `rr` in the whole object is Step_0:98, `rr = choose(0);` - a vestigial one-option roll that happens AFTER the spawn and is never read again (there is no `rr ==` test anywhere in the file); it is a leftover from the copy-paste ancestor this Step shares with obj_smallcheckers_enemy.

turnByChoice.note: HAND-ESTIMATED from the state machines in gml_Object_obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml - NOT read off a scr_turntimer call, because there is none. Derived by summing each branch's timers and ballistic arcs against the fixed geometry (boss at viewY+120, box floor at viewY+245, spr_checkers_leap 84px at image_yscale 2 = 168px). Round up ~10%: the game itself never truncates these, so erring long is harmless and erring short cuts the animation. The correct engine behaviour is to let obj_checkers_leap end the turn (global.turntimer = -1) and treat these numbers only as a safety cap.

real.name: leapmode 0 - Stomp (3 leaps onto the box floor, body is the hitbox)
real.evidence: Chooser Step_0:67-68 (`if (attacktype == 0) rr = 0;`) with attacktype = 0 from Create_0.gml:37, so this is ALWAYS the first enemy turn of both fights. Body: obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml:1-92. Three charge-and-leap cycles (jumpcon 0 -> 1) that land on `obj_growtangle.y + sprite_height/2 - sprite_height` (:7, :11) - the box floor - then a fourth jump with `active = 0` that returns to xstart (:67-74) and ends the turn at :84. Spawns NO bullets at all: the leap object itself is the hazard (parent obj_collidebullet -> obj_bulletparent per objects.tsv; obj_heart_Collision_obj_collidebullet.gml:1-2 fires event_user(5), and obj_checkers_leap_Other_15.gml:1-2 is `if (active == 1) scr_damage();`). Charge is 20 frames on the first leap and 10 after (`jumpmax` at :45-48), launch vspeed -17 then -15 (:59-62).

real.name: leapmode 3 - Leg Sweep (4 volleys x 4 aimed shrapnel)
real.evidence: Chooser Step_0:70-71 (`if (attacktype == 1) rr = 3;`) - note the deliberate out-of-order mapping, slot 1 fires leapmode 3. Body: obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml:346-433. Uses spr_checkers_leg (6 frames, image_speed 0.5) and fires on the exact frame `image_index == 3` (:364): four obj_regularbullet at (x-40, y+100) with spr_checkershrapnel, aimed with `point_direction(...obj_heart.x + 8, obj_heart.y + 8) - (10 * i) + random(i * 20)` and speed `3.5 + random(1.8)` (:369-377). Four volleys (amt >= 4 at :404), then a 30-frame wind-down that fades every obj_regularbullet (:412-432) and ends the turn at :427. All live bullets also grow 0.01 in each scale per frame for the whole attack (:348-352).

real.name: leapmode 1 - Slam (2 hover-slams, 6 shrapnel fanned from each impact)
real.evidence: Chooser Step_0:73-74 (`if (attacktype == 2) rr = 1;`). Body: obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml:94-223. Charge 20 frames, leap toward `obj_heart.x + 8` with vspeed -17 (:139-149), freeze at apex when vspeed >= 0 (:163-173), hover 15 frames flashing (:175-189), then slam down at vspeed 32 leaving afterimages (:191-194). On impact with the box floor it spawns 6 obj_regularbullet in a fan across `130 - random(10) - 70*(i/5)` degrees, speed `6 + random(1)`, gravity 0.25, scale 1.5 (:196-213). Two slams (amt >= 3 at :152 turns the third charge into the retreat), then a 20-frame wind-down (:96-118) ending the turn at :111.

real.name: leapmode 2 - Magnificent Ascent (floats up-left raining shrapnel, 2 homing)
real.evidence: Chooser Step_0:76-77 (`if (attacktype == 3) rr = 2;`). Body: obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml:225-343. Plays spr_checkers_magnificent to its last frame (5 frames, `image_index >= 4` at :240), then rises with `hspeed = -4; gravity = -0.12;` plus a `y += sin(siner/3) * 4` wobble (:244-254). From s_timer 24 it drops one obj_regularbullet every 3 frames (:260-284) with `vspeed = 3`, `gravity_direction = 135 + random(180)`, `gravity = 0.06`; the 7th and 13th (`magamt == 6 || magamt == 12`, :273-280) instead lose gravity and `move_towards_point(obj_heart.x + 8, obj_heart.y + 8, 3)` - the only homing bullets K. Round has. When it clears viewY-200 it teleports to (xstart+300, ystart-100) and flies back in at hspeed -30 (:286-295), lands, then a 30-frame wind-down ends the turn at :337. Roughly 17 bullets per turn at the default box geometry.

cut.name: leapmode 4 - short-hop stomp (weaker duplicate of leapmode 0)
cut.evidence: obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml:436-508. Unreachable: `leapmode` is written in exactly two places in the whole Chapter 1 dump - obj_checkers_leap_Create_0.gml:6 (`leapmode = 0;`) and obj_checkers_enemy_Step_0.gml:80 (`dc.leapmode = rr;`) - and `rr` at that point can only be 0, 3, 1 or 2 (Step_0:67-77, driven by attacktype 0..3, which Step_0:83-86 wraps at 3). Verified by `grep -rn leapmode` over the whole Ch1 dump: 6 hits, no other assignment. The branch is an earlier, tamer draft of leapmode 0 - 16-frame charge instead of 20/10, vspeed -12 instead of -17/-15, hspeed divisor 24 instead of 28, and it lands back on `floory` (the boss's own y) rather than on the box floor, so the checker never actually enters the box. Like leapmode 0 it spawns no bullets. It is byte-identical in Chapters 1-5 (diff of gml_Object_obj_checkers_leap_Step_0.gml Ch1 vs Ch2 is empty), so it was never revived later either.

cut.name: unused Create fields inherited from the shared enemy template
cut.evidence: obj_checkers_enemy_Create_0.gml:1, :24, :26, :27, :13, :14, :3, :19, :21, :20. None of bikeflip / nexttry / tired / candodge / dodgetimer appears anywhere in the object's six events (grep returns only the Create lines). turnt/hurt/hurttimer are read by Draw_0:3-14 but nothing ever sets state = 3 inside this object.

mechanics:
NOT a bullet-spawner boss. There is no obj_dbulletcontroller, no scr_bulletspawner and no `.type` field anywhere in the fight: obj_checkers_enemy creates ONE obj_checkers_leap per turn (Step_0:79) and hands it `leapmode`, `target` and `damage`. obj_checkers_leap is itself the attack - it is a child of obj_collidebullet (objects.tsv) so the checker's own body damages the soul while `active == 1` (obj_checkers_leap_Other_15.gml), it spawns its own obj_regularbullet shrapnel where it needs to, and it ends the turn by writing global.turntimer = -1.

ATTACK ORDER IS DETERMINISTIC. `attacktype` cycles 0,1,2,3,0,... (Create_0.gml:37; Step_0:83-86) and maps to leapmode 0, 3, 1, 2 (Step_0:67-77). There is no randomness in the selection at all - only in the bullet spread (`random(...)` inside each branch). Both fights start from attacktype 0, so turn 1 is always the Stomp.

TURN SHAPE (Step_0:14-114). On the first frame of the enemy turn (global.mnfight == 1, talked == 0): scr_randomtarget(), create obj_darkener, compute milkmax, and - only if HP > milkmax - scr_moveheart() and the obj_growtangle box (Step_0:26-33). Then rtimer counts to 12 with global.turntimer held at 120 (Step_0:112), and at rtimer == 12 the boss either drinks milk (HP <= milkmax) or spawns the leap, sets `visible = 0`, `turns += 1` and parks global.turntimer at 999. Note that on a MILK turn there is no box and no soul at all.

MILK PHASE (Step_0:58-62 gate, :135-301 body). `milkmax` is 1000 while milk_counter == 0 and 600 afterwards (Step_0:21-24 and :53-56). When the enemy turn begins with HP <= milkmax, K. Round skips its attack entirely and drinks milk instead: `global.monsterat[myself] += 0.5` capped at 10, and HP += 300 the first time / 700 every time after (Step_0:221-230). Ch2's literal copy of the same lines gives the text: "* K. ROUND felt stressed out and attacked!", "* K. ROUND practiced self-care!", "* K. ROUND's HP and ATTACK went up!" (Ch2 obj_checkers_enemy_Step_0.gml:146, :159, :276). This is REPEATABLE - scon returns to 0 at :266/:293 and milkmax stays 600 - so damage alone cannot win the fight unless you burst it from above the threshold to 0 in a single turn. In the rematch `secondtime == 1` presets milk_counter = 99 (Step_0:8-9), so milkmax is 600 from the start, the heal is the full 700 and the Susie/Ralsei milk dialogue is skipped.

THE REAL WIN CONDITION IS THE CROWN (Step_0:634-638: `if (crown >= 100) { global.mercymod[myself] = 999; actcon = 50; }`). ACTs feed `crown`: Bow +15 (first fight) / +18 (rematch) at Step_0:344-348, Deep Bow +20 at Step_0:460. sparepoint is 0 and mercymax is 100, so crown is the only mercy route. At actcon 50 the boss goes invisible, snd_free_all(), and spawns obj_checker_animtest with type = 1 and sprite spr_smallchecker_transform3 (Step_0:673-683) - the crown-flies-off transformation into the little checker.

ACT MENU (Step_0:303-683, gated on global.myfight == 3; obj_battlecontroller_Step_0.gml:552 sets acting = index + 1). actactor semantics from obj_battlecontroller_Step_0.gml:529-566: 1 = Kris alone, 2 = Kris+Susie, 3 = Kris+Ralsei, 4 = Kris+Susie+Ralsei. FIRST FIGHT: acting 1 Check (also sets global.flag[246] = 1 and renames its own act to "Checkers"), acting 2 Bow, acting 3 Deep Bow (Kris and Ralsei both bow, +20), acting 4 Warning (Ralsei explains Susie is dangerous; on the third use `global.battleat[2] *= 1.5`, Step_0:623 - slot 2 is Susie because the party order at that point is Kris/Ralsei/Susie). REMATCH: acting 1 Check, acting 2 Bow, acting 3 "Susie's Idea" which after one dialogue turn becomes "Throw" - an aiming minigame using obj_throwtarget + obj_throwralsei (Step_0:552-602, :645-671), resolved by obj_ralseithrown_Collision_obj_throwtarget.gml.

SOUL: plain red only. scr_moveheart() -> obj_moveheart -> obj_heart (gml_GlobalScript_scr_moveheart.gml). No green/blue/purple mode, no obj_heartblcon speech bubble handling, no phases beyond the milk gate.
engineNeeds:
1) NO CONTROLLER/TYPE MODEL. Every other roster launches an attack as `spawner -> controller.type = N`. K. Round has neither: the launch is `dc = instance_create(x, y, obj_checkers_leap); dc.leapmode = rr; dc.target = mytarget; dc.damage = global.monsterat[myself] * 5;` (Step_0:79-82). The studio needs a launch mode that creates obj_checkers_leap AT THE BOSS'S x/y (xstart/ystart are read all over the branch: :31, :71, :156, :291, :309, :457, :487) and sets leapmode, not type. gen_attacks.js's `.type` extraction returns null for all five branches, and its controller regex mis-reports obj_shake / obj_regularbullet - see selectorScan.note.

2) THE ATTACK OBJECT IS ALSO A BULLET. obj_checkers_leap's parent is obj_collidebullet (objects.tsv), so it must be registered with the soul's collision set, must honour its `active` flag (obj_checkers_leap_Other_15.gml), and must NOT be culled by whatever cleans up obj_bulletparent at turn end before it has written global.turntimer = -1 (obj_battlecontroller_Step_0.gml:837-838 destroys obj_bulletparent on turn close, which is why the leap ends the turn itself and then self-destructs).

3) SELF-TERMINATING TURN. There is no scr_turntimer anywhere in this fight; global.turntimer is parked at 999 and driven to -1 by the leap. The studio must either honour that write or use turnByChoice as a cap. A default 90/120-frame floor truncates all four attacks (they run ~125-175 frames).

4) HARD DEPENDENCIES, ALL UNGUARDED. obj_growtangle is dereferenced with no instance_exists check in leapmode 0 (:7, :11) and leapmode 1 (:196, :204, :215) - the checker's landing height IS the box floor, so a missing or differently-sized box changes the whole attack, not just the visuals. obj_heart is dereferenced with no guard in all four real branches (:58, :145, :278, :373). obj_regularbullet destroys itself in its own Create if obj_heart is absent (obj_regularbullet_Create_0.gml:12-13). Also needed: obj_shake (:10, :29, :200, :306), scr_afterimage (:193, used per-frame during the leapmode 1 slam), obj_afterimage (via obj_growtangle's own grow animation).

5) BOX GEOMETRY IS LOAD-BEARING AND CH1-SPECIFIC. Ch1's obj_growtangle has no maxxscale/maxyscale (Create_0.gml:1-11) - it hard-codes scale 2 in its Step (:17-18) over 15 frames. If the studio reuses a Ch2+ growtangle that reads maxxscale/maxyscale, the box will be the wrong size and leapmodes 0 and 1 will land in the wrong place or, if it grows slower than 15 frames, mid-air (leapmode 0's first leap lands around frame 51 of the turn, comfortably after the box finishes growing).

6) BOSS-SIDE STATE THE DISPATCH BLOCK NEEDS. `attacktype` (int, persists across turns and is mutated by the block), `mytarget` (set by scr_randomtarget(), Step_0:16 - and scr_damage re-rolls it if the target is down, gml_GlobalScript_scr_damage.gml:16-17), and global.monsterat[myself]. Damage per hit is at*5 = 37.5 in the first fight, 40 in the rematch, and it RISES 2.5 per milk (at += 0.5, capped at 10 -> max 50).

7) THE MILK TURN IS A TURN REPLACEMENT, not an attack. If the studio ever runs the fight for real rather than launching single attacks, it needs the scon 1 -> 1.5 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> (6) chain (Step_0:135-301), which is dialogue-gated on obj_writer, uses scr_dark_marker/spr_checkers_milk, obj_dmgwriter type 3 and obj_healanim, and produces NO box and NO soul.

8) SPRITES ALL PRESENT in the Ch1 export: spr_checkers_idle (8f, 43x77), spr_checkers_crouch (1f, 48x84), spr_checkers_leap (3f, 48x84), spr_checkers_leg (6f, 70x77 - the `image_index == 3` bullet frame and the `>= 5` stop both rely on that count), spr_checkers_magnificent (5f, 116x78 - `image_index >= 4` is its last frame), spr_checkershrapnel (1f, 16x16, origin centred), spr_checkers_bow (6f), spr_checkers_milk (1f). Everything is drawn at image_x/yscale 2 (Create_0.gml:33-34, leap Create_0.gml:4-5) and Draw_0 hand-draws the idle at 2x with `siner / 3` as the frame index. Sounds used: snd_jump, snd_impact, snd_boost, snd_ultraswing, snd_swing, snd_magicsprinkle (all present in sounds.tsv).

9) DIFFICULTY: there is none. No `difficulty` field is set or read anywhere in this fight. The only per-fight variation is monstertype 10 vs 21 (AT 7.5 vs 8) and the `secondtime` presets.
